verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community remark that SvelteKit's first-party 'form actions' are 'amazing'. That points to a framework-integrated form-handling feature, but the pack contains no first-party documentation of it and nothing about form validation. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing form building/actions, any validation module or API, evidence of integration details (e.g. progressive enhancement, typed errors), independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.
